_doc: Client-query-style factorial seed set (Fable step 2). Each family gives a NEUTRAL situation (q_seed) and a banned-token list (avoid) so different client models author a recall query WITHOUT leaking passage vocabulary. relevant_ids are the two cross-project instantiations (A+B) from eval-H7-vocab-divergence-2026-07-08.json; the *_TA passage in that pool is a decoy (NOT relevant). Passages are reused frozen from H7 — only query STYLE varies by client.
